open_items: UNICEF: still degraded, unchanged since last run. Failing continuously from cycle 1395 through 1408 (14 cycles, ~28h): gateway data, direct data, direct json, all HTTP 404; constraint:availableconstraint contract broken (expected 200, observed 404). Metadata/structure still 200. Not re-rechecked live this run since shape is unchanged from the last live-verified check (cycle 1405). Next run: re-check live again if this keeps extending, and watch whether it ever flips to provider_down/gateway_issue instead of degraded.

ESTAT flapped healthy -> gateway_issue -> healthy between cycles 1406 and 1408 (single-cycle occurrence at 1407, 'gateway metadata: Error:'), already resolved. Logged in incidents.md as another occurrence of the chronic empty-exception bug below. No open action beyond the standing bug.
STATSNZ auth:listing capability_appeared, first seen cycle 60, still present at cycle 1408. Still open, not re-reported since no new change.
claude/ triage branches on origin: 161 as of this run (161 last run, unchanged), still well above the 20 the skill flags for pruning; not actioned by this read-only routine.
Monitor bug (standing): /api/history computes status without contracts, so a contract-only degraded state never shows up in /api/history, only in /api/status and /api/contracts.

Chronic gateway bug (empty 'Error: ' message from tools/sdmx_tools.py around lines 207-209 catching Exception with an empty str(e)): previously traced on ABS (many occurrences, most recently cycle 1403), ESTAT (cycles 1143, 1335, 1365, 1371, 1395, 1407), ECB (cycles 1337, 1339-adjacent, 1345, 1357, 1385-1386, 1388), and IMF (cycle 1368). Still unfixed; recommend actually addressing the exception handler given it now recurs across four providers with a fifth occurrence this run.

Long-running architectural facts, not incidents: ILO /availableconstraint/ returns 500 (constraints come via ?references=all); ECB does not support /availableconstraint/ (404 is expected, not an error); ESTAT has no practical constraint support; ESTAT direct json check is skipped by design (Eurostat returns 406 for SDMx-JSON); IMF direct json check is skipped by design (IMF ignores the JSON Accept header and returns XML); STATSNZ direct json check is skipped by design (Stats NZ ignores the JSON Accept header and returns CSV); BIS/IMF/ILO references:contentconstraint reads ignored (accepted and silently dropped); encoding:structure_xml charset/version order flips cosmetically from time to time, verdict stays ok (flipped again this run on ILO and OECD).
